spans.s: (cf. शम्बली and शम्भली) a procuress, L.
mf(आ)n. (√ फल्) rich in fruit or seed, fruitful, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 64,
full-blown, blossomed, fully opened or expanded (as a flower), Kāv.; Rājat.

(prob. for सं-स्फेट, q.v.) mutual conflict or encounter of angry persons, angry or passionate contention (in dram. one of the 13 elements of the विमर्श [q.v.], illustrated by the altercation between Śakuntalā and the king in Śak.; or as one of the 4 elements of the आरभटि [q.v.], illustrated by the encounter of Mādhava and Aghora-ghaṇṭa in Mālatīm.), Bhar.; Daśar.; Sāh.
